candidates.change_summary: Replace the return value `true` with `false` at the end of the function.
Remove the `revert()` statement inside the if block, so that the function always returns true even if a call fails.
Replace `uint _value = v * 10 ** _decimals;` with `uint _value = v;` so the token amount sent differs when `_decimals > 0`.
Delete `require(_tos.length > 0);` so call with empty `_tos` array succeeds (returns true) instead of reverting.
Replace the for-loop upper bound `_tos.length` with `_tos.length - 1` to skip the last recipient.
Delete the revert statement inside the failure check so the function returns true even when a sub-call fails.
